name: app-lavender-solution-roadmap-floating-cards-on-s-curve
title: Solution Roadmap on an S-Curve Path
whatItIs: A tall lavender sheet titled The Solution Roadmap with a dashed S-curve connecting four indigo icon nodes with ghost numerals and goals, each paired with floating UI cards (calendar, meal reminders, medication and mood charts, safe-zone map).
whatItMeans: The winding path makes a list of goals feel like a journey, and each goal shows its UI as proof.
techniques: Dashed S-curve linking round icon nodes
Floating UI cards beside every node
Single indigo hue with pastel accents

vocabulary.definition: A curved line joining goals in sequence.
A circular icon marking a stop on a path.
A large faint number beside a heading.
